syllabus_topics: Descriptive statistics: mean, standard deviation, double series, least squares method.
Probability reminders: usual laws (binomial, Gauss, Poisson, Chi-square).
Inferential statistics: sampling and estimations, hypothesis testing.
Matrix Calculus: Matrix operations, determinants, eigenvalues/eigenvectors, change of basis.
Particular matrices (symmetric, antisymmetric, positive definite, Hermitian).
assessment_rules: Two exams will be used, with an overall average weighted proportionally to the hours of each sub-module.
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
